fourviere.name: Basilica of Notre-Dame de Fourvière
fourviere.price_text: Free entry · guided rooftop tours cost extra
fourviere.hours: Daily roughly 07:00–19:00 · check on the day
fourviere.tip: Climb the hill on the funicular, then walk down through the gardens for city views.
fourviere.best: Morning or late afternoon; clear days

vieux-lyon.name: Vieux Lyon
vieux-lyon.hours: Always open · shops and cafés daytime
vieux-lyon.tip: Look for the traboules, hidden covered passages through the old buildings.
vieux-lyon.best: Morning for quiet streets, evening for dinner

groupama.name: Groupama Stadium
groupama.price_text: Match and tour prices vary · check on the day
groupama.hours: Only on match days or booked tours
groupama.tip: It sits well outside the centre; allow extra time by tram or car.

saone-cruise.name: Saône River Cruise
saone-cruise.price_text: ≈ €15–25 per adult · check on the day
saone-cruise.tip: Book a late-afternoon sailing to see the old town from the water in soft light.

fourviere-viewpoint.name: Fourvière esplanade viewpoint
fourviere-viewpoint.tip: Best free panorama over the city; come at dusk when lights come on.

croix-rousse-walk.name: Croix-Rousse hill walk
croix-rousse-walk.tip: Walk up through the traboules and silk-worker streets, then rest at the boulevard cafés.

les-halles.name: Les Halles de Lyon Paul Bocuse
les-halles.price_text: Free to enter · food priced per item
les-halles.hours: Tue–Sat roughly 07:00–19:00 · check on the day
les-halles.tip: Go hungry and try a praline tart or a plate of charcuterie at a counter.

bouchon-dinner.name: Bouchon dinner in Vieux Lyon
bouchon-dinner.price_text: ≈ €30–50 per person · check on the day
bouchon-dinner.tip: Book ahead and expect hearty Lyonnais dishes; portions are large.

presqu-ile-walk.name: Presqu'île walk
presqu-ile-walk.tip: Stroll from Place Bellecour to Place des Terreaux for shops, squares and cafés.

parc-tete-or.name: Parc de la Tête d'Or
parc-tete-or.hours: Daily, roughly dawn to dusk · check on the day
parc-tete-or.tip: Big city park with a lake and free zoo; good for a slow morning with kids.
parc-tete-or.best: Morning or late afternoon, spring to autumn

confluence-museum.name: Musée des Confluences
confluence-museum.tip: Striking modern building at the river junction; allow a couple of hours inside.

traboule-tour.name: Guided traboule walking tour
traboule-tour.price_text: ≈ €12–20 per person · check on the day
traboule-tour.tip: A guide opens the hidden passages you would miss alone; book a day ahead.

bellecour.name: Place Bellecour
bellecour.tip: Central meeting point with a view up to Fourvière; good start for a city walk.

terreaux.name: Place des Terreaux and fountain
terreaux.tip: Sit by the fountain and use it as a base for the museum and Croix-Rousse climb.

beaux-arts.name: Musée des Beaux-Arts de Lyon
beaux-arts.tip: Calm, well-sized collection in an old abbey; good rainy-day stop.

saone-banks.name: Saône riverbank walk
saone-banks.tip: Follow the lower quays for a quiet walk below the old town walls.

st-jean-cathedral.name: Saint-Jean Cathedral
st-jean-cathedral.hours: Daily daytime · check on the day
st-jean-cathedral.tip: Step inside for the old astronomical clock and quiet stone interior.

resistance-museum.name: Centre d'Histoire de la Résistance et de la Déportation
resistance-museum.tip: Strong, well-presented museum on Lyon in the war years; allow time to read.

guignol-show.name: Guignol puppet show
guignol-show.price_text: ≈ €8–12 per person · check on the day
guignol-show.tip: A classic Lyon tradition for families; check the schedule before you go.

confluence-walk.name: Confluence district walk
confluence-walk.tip: New riverside architecture and open space; pair it with the museum.
